_reviewProvenance: Full tier for an additive release: both directions, the manifest's 45 checkers (Direction A over the 40 brief docs, Direction B over the 5 surfaces), each run twice as a pair, an Opus 5.5 agent and a Sonnet 5.5 agent, each reading its prompt verbatim from a file holding the manifest's pinned context and direction template filled for its item. Run by hand through the host's agent tool in 11 groups, each group run as an Opus 5.5 and a Sonnet 5.5 agent, at most six agents at a time. The checkers read an exact export of the first roll 00e0bd83567074532d21ad5f167d1283851340a2 with the binary built from it; this receipt names the re-cut content commit 0de27c795bb18e621253b3f5fdfa8bff30f1cfda, which differs from it only by RELEASE.md (the persona quote the docs-currency review's dc-1 held on, removed) and .abcd/work/reviews/README.md (one link moved from the removed DECISIONS.md to ../decisions/, dc-3's fix, 1fab6e304): the first roll was reverted (77a9d8c27) and re-cut, and the re-cut's CHANGELOG.md, archived .abcd/development/releases/0.14.2.md and marketplace pin are byte-identical to the first roll's. No brief doc or surface a checker read changed. Findings were merged by location (the file:line a finding names, first kept): Opus raised 48 and Sonnet 23, 61 merged, 41 from Opus alone and 18 from Sonnet alone. Folding: 11 merged findings naming the same claim at a neighbouring line or in the same sentence were folded into the finding they repeat, locations that named a section rather than a file:line were replaced by the line read, one finding naming two glossary files was split in two because the ledger already holds one record for each, and the 18-ideate.md finding that ideate's citation refusal omits dcn-N is the same defect as the docs-currency review's dc-5 and is recorded there once. Each remaining finding was re-verified against 0de27c795bb18e621253b3f5fdfa8bff30f1cfda with a grep or the binary's --help. 50 remain, every one in brief prose and none on a user-facing page: 1 is invalid on re-verification, and 49 are deferred, each to its own open record, 24 of them to records captured at v0.14.1 or v0.14.2 that still hold the same finding. Coverage limits stated by the checkers: some long chapters were spot-checked rather than read claim by claim, and behaviour needing a live forge or remote was checked in source.
